condition: recombinant cargo-free pore-engineered shell expressed in E. coli
source: Williams et al. 2018; Adamson et al. 2022
notes: Complete pore-loop deletion/enlarged-pore variant. 6WKV and 7LIT represent the same S7G design and are therefore grouped. Williams et al. estimated an ~11 Å pore; Adamson et al. later calculated ~11.3 Å from the higher-resolution structure. Shell diameter of 24 nm observed by negative-stain TEM.
